High-level transcript items for append-only terminal history.

Controllers construct these semantic items and append them through the fat-prompt runtime. Formatters in display/tool modules can still build item bodies, but this module owns item markers, trimming, and item separators.

Imports

display, fatprompt, types, util

Types

TranscriptItem = object
  kind*: TranscriptKind
  marker*: string
  title*: string
  body*: string
  attachSeparator*: bool
TranscriptKind = enum
  tiUserPrompt, tiAssistant, tiTool, tiCommand
